arms.btc_hold: buy-and-hold BTC over the sim calendar
arms.no_filter: entry = gate-on AND top-quintile only; identical pyramid/exits — isolates the entry filter's value

caveats: close basis + daily bars: intra-day stops are coarse — an 8% trail can lose far more than 8% through a gap day
margined adds = implicit leverage up to ~1.75x notional
early-stopped symbols are kept (mega includes delisted — a PLUS for survivorship honesty); campaigns on them are reported explicitly
second-hand archive copy, not an as-of vintage

cohort.assets: 277 USDT-M perps, 2021-01-01 -> 2025-12-30, close basis; includes 11 delisted/renamed early-stoppers (listed/last_bar_date on every record)

definitions.concurrency: MAX_CONCURRENT=1 — one campaign at a time, full equity deployed at entry (chosen over max-2 for a clean single-book equity curve)
definitions.costs: 5bps per fill; funding carry skipped (signal only)
definitions.entry: BTC ret20>0 AND dfh20 XS mid-rank pct>=0.8 (top quintile, >=30 ranked) AND dfh20 in [-0.12,-0.03] AND close>prev_close AND (funding_pct<0.8 if funded). Highest rank wins; fill at signal-day close.
definitions.fills: all at day-t close on day-t PIT features — the same close basis as the cohort labels; 'next bar open' approximated by that close on daily bars
definitions.funding_pct: per-asset mid-rank pct of last_funding_rate vs trailing-180 daily values (MIN_WINDOW=20)
definitions.pyramid: unrealized>=+3% vs vwap AND gate-on AND still top-quintile -> add 50% of position (qty*0.5 at mark), max 2 adds, margined perp-style (cash goes negative, ~1.75x max notional)

purpose: T119: rolling-campaign simulator — the full entry -> pyramid -> exit state machine — measured on the 277-symbol mega PIT cohort vs a no-entry-filter sibling and buy-and-hold BTC.
